name: @pipeworx/mcp-nflverse

tools.name: nfl_player_season_stats
tools.description: NFL player season totals from nflverse, 1999–current: passing, rushing, receiving, defense, kicking and returns, with EPA, CPOE, target share and fantasy points. Look up by player name or nflverse/GSIS id. Example: Joe Burrow 2024 → 4,918 passing yards, 43 TD. Returns found:false when no player matches.

player.description: Player name ("Lamar Jackson", partial names match) or nflverse/GSIS player id ("00-0034796").

season.description: NFL season year (1999–current). The 2024 season includes its January–February 2025 playoff games. Defaults to the current season.

season_type.description: REG (regular season, default), POST (playoffs) or REGPOST (combined).

tools.name: nfl_team_game_log
tools.description: Game-by-game NFL team log for one season from nflverse: opponent, home/away, final score and W/L, plus passing, rushing, EPA, turnovers, penalties, sacks and kicking per game.

season.description: NFL season year (1999–current). The 2024 season includes its January–February 2025 playoff games. Defaults to the current season.

tools.name: nfl_play_by_play
tools.description: Every play of one NFL game from nflverse play-by-play (1999–current): down, distance, field position, play type, yards, the official play description, passer/rusher/receiver, score, expected points added (EPA) and win probability. Filter by quarter or play type. Find game ids with nfl_schedule.

limit.description: Max plays returned (default 300, max 400). A full game is ~150–200 rows.

tools.name: nfl_schedule
tools.description: NFL schedule and results for a season from nflverse (1999–current): game ids, dates, kickoff times, scores, overtime, closing spread and total, stadium, roof, surface, weather, starting QBs, coaches and referee. Filter by week and/or team.

season.description: NFL season year (1999–current). The 2024 season includes its January–February 2025 playoff games. Defaults to the current season.

week.description: Week number (1–18 regular season; playoff weeks follow).

tools.name: nfl_injuries
tools.description: Official NFL weekly injury reports from nflverse (2009–current): player, team, position, game status (Out, Doubtful, Questionable) and practice participation, latest week first. Filter by team, week or player name.

season.description: NFL season year (2009–current). Defaults to the current season.

player.description: Player name or part of it.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-nflverse forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the nflverse pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
